executiveSummary: The OT/ICS threat landscape this period is characterized by active, government-confirmed campaigns targeting programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and industrial edge gateways, combined with high-impact perimeter vulnerabilities that enable rapid IT-to-OT pivoting. U.S. multi-agency advisories detail Iranian-affiliated intrusions modifying PLC logic and HMI/SCADA displays across U.S. water and energy operations, with observed operational disruption and financial losses Security Advisory . A second joint alert warns of ongoing targeting of Siemens S7-series PLCs over S7comm/TCP 102 using readily-available or AI-scripted tooling, underscoring continued risks to core industrial control assets Security Advisory . Critical perimeter risks remain elevated: JPCERT/CC reports mass leakage and offline cracking of Fortinet FortiGate administrative credentials ("FortiBleed"), enabling VPN compromise and AD credential theft-highly relevant to OT perimeters where FortiGate protects conduits to ICS Alert . Separately, a pre-auth RCE in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC enables swift enterprise compromise and potential OT pivoting via remote access gateways used for vendor/jump-host access Alert . Field and remote-site equipment risks are rising: research uncovered OEM backdoors in widely resold ZBT LTE/5G routers that provide unauthenticated command execution and cloud-controlled C2, a serious concern for remote stations and substations using cellular failover View Article . CISA summaries also highlight critical flaws in EV charging infrastructure (EVbee DC-80) enabling unauthenticated control and command injection that could disrupt energy/transport operations Bulletin . Multiple KEV additions and exploited app stacks (Zimbra OS command injection; MLflow SSRF; PaperCut NG/MF issues) continue to supply initial access paths that regularly appear in intrusions impacting critical infrastructure enterprises; urgent patching and compromise assessment are advised CISA KEV CISA KEV . Priority: Harden PLC access and engineering pathways Urgent: Patch/assess NetScaler & FortiGate estates Reduce: Internet exposure of EVSE/routers/BI stacks

relevance: The most consequential items directly affect control-system components and perimeters: (1) PLC-focused intrusions (Iran-affiliated and Siemens S7-specific) represent immediate risk to process integrity and safety; (2) NetScaler and FortiGate issues threaten remote access boundaries commonly bridging IT and OT; (3) EVSE flaws introduce operational risks in transportation/energy ecosystems; and (4) backdoored LTE/5G routers amplify remote-site compromise likelihood. Multiple KEV-listed enterprise apps (Zimbra, MLflow, PaperCut, Metabase) continue to provide initial access and credential theft for subsequent lateral movement toward OT enclaves.

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploitation of public-facing apps/gateways (NetScaler ADC RCE; TrueConf pre-auth RCE; KEVs in Zimbra/MLflow/Metabase) - ATT&CK T1190
Persistence: Web shells on appliances/servers; router implants (Cisco IOS XR); application passcodes & IMAP persistence (Zimbra) - T1505, T1053
Credential Access: VPN credential theft/cracking (FortiBleed); TACACS+ interception; LSASS dumps - T1003, T1557
Lateral Movement: Reverse tunnels (SSH, Python/WebSockets); AD CS abuse; SMB/RDP - T1021, T1550, T1557
Collection/Exfiltration: DNS/HTTPS covert channels; cloud storage (OneDrive/Graph); EVSE/OCPP data paths - T1041, T1071
Impact on OT: PLC program/logic writes; HMI alarm suppression/setpoint changes; EVSE command injection - ICS ATT&CK: Impact/Modify Control Logic

outlook72h: High likelihood of opportunistic exploitation against unpatched NetScaler ADC and KEV-listed Zimbra/MLflow/Metabase. Validate patch coverage and scan logs for webshell/abnormal admin actions now. Expect continued probing of S7comm/CIP/Modbus from internet/VPN paths. Proactively block TCP/102/44818/2222 at perimeters and tighten PLC access lists; baseline S7comm writes for anomaly alerts. Rapid triage EVSE/remote routers: identify EVbee/ZBT devices; isolate from corporate/OT networks pending patch/firmware verification. Task SOC to threat-hunt TacACS+/router implants (Fire Ant/UNC3886 TTPs) and TrueConf web shell/installer tampering across management planes.
